blocks.x: Research guide, validation plan, and cheapest tests for the FASTag Trust Layer.
Prepared for Sai Kiran Biswal | Generated 19 Jun 2026

Validate whether toll users and fleet operators value a unified toll health, explainability, and dispute-control layer enough to adopt it, and whether operators/issuers can support the minimum event data needed for a trustworthy MVP.

rows: Segment
Count
Recruiting filter
Daily commuters
Cross tolls at least 8 times/month; have faced recharge/status/pass uncertainty.
Occasional highway travellers
Took 2+ intercity road trips in the last 6 months.
Fleet owners/admins
Operate 10+ vehicles with regular toll crossings.
Drivers
Actually encounter toll booth problems; use WhatsApp/SMS.
Toll operator staff
Handle failed reads, class mismatch, disputes, congestion.
Issuer/payment support teams
Understand KYC, blacklisting, recharge, dispute workflows.

blocks.x: Walk me through the last time your FASTag failed or caused anxiety before travel.
What exactly did you do when the issue happened? Which app, bank, phone number, or toll counter did you use?
What information did you wish you had before reaching the toll plaza?
Tell me about the last wrong or confusing toll deduction. How did you verify it?
For annual pass users: how do you know where it applies, how many trips are left, and whether the pass was used?
For fleet operators: how do you currently monitor toll spend, low balance, blocked tags, and disputes?
What would make you trust an app that says your vehicle is toll-ready?
What should never be automated by AI in this workflow?

rows: Hypothesis
Cheapest test
Decision rule
Users will check toll health before trips if it explains specific issues
Clickable prototype with 20 vehicle owners
Go if >=60% say they would check before a trip and can correctly explain issue/fix.
Dispute tracker reduces support anxiety
Prototype transaction and dispute flow with past complainants
Go if >=50% prefer it over current bank/support process and can finish in <60 sec.
Fleet admins will pay for a multi-vehicle toll control tower
Figma/HTML demo + pricing discussion with 10 fleet owners
Go if >=3 agree to paid pilot or LOI-style follow-up.
Operator exception queue reduces manual work
Shadow-mode analysis on sample toll events
Go if duplicate/class/read anomalies can be flagged with useful precision.
Annual pass optimizer is understood by users
Pass comparison screen test
Go if >=70% understand pass vs wallet usage and validity.
Metric
Target after pilot
Issue diagnosis coverage
>=80% of warning/blocked states have a specific reason and CTA.
Dispute creation time
<60 seconds for common wrong/double deduction cases.
User comprehension
>=70% of test users can explain why a transaction was charged.
Fleet at-risk detection
>=90% of low-balance/blocked vehicles surfaced before travel.
Operator exception usefulness
>=50% reduction in manually triaged low-value exception cases in pilot sample.
